answer_1.quote: In this paper, we first identify the four biases of interest: Misinformation Oversight Bias, Gender Bias, Authority Bias and Beauty Bias, which are crucial in natural language generation (NLG) evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: free-form text answers to open-ended questions

answer_2.quote: Attack Successful Rate (ASR) ... is the percentage of samples with preference shifted towards the perturbed answer from control to experimental group.

answer_3.quote: We also exploit the uncovered biases to perform attacks on LLM judges.

answer_4.quote: We employ 60 college students as our human judges.
answer_4.guideline: Each judge is instructed to determine whether 'Answer 1' is better, 'Answer 2' is better, or a 'Tie', based solely on the semantic quality of the answers.
